body: `madoqua run` checks only the staged files, so a commit in a large repo takes 0.3 s instead of 2 s.
A `pyproject.toml` with an empty `[tool.biston]` table no longer makes `biston scan` crash.
`gerenuk audit --json` prints the unused symbols as JSON, for scripts and CI.
The `madoqua timings` command is gone; `madoqua stats` shows the same numbers.
